transition_18a: Title 18-C applies to estates of decedents who die on or after 2019-09-01, and to any proceeding pending on or commenced after that date. For a decedent who died before 2019-09-01, former Title 18-A supplies the substantive succession rules even though the proceeding itself runs under 18-C. See _index/18a-key-diffs.json (governing rule: 18-C §8-301).

caselaw.name: Estate of Bonin
caselaw.topic: Personal representative — removal and surcharge for failure of duty
caselaw.holding: A personal representative was removed and surcharged for failing fiduciary duties (including lost interest from not depositing proceeds in interest-bearing accounts and refund of excessive fees). (Former 18-A; principle continues in 18-C §§3-712, 3-611.)

caselaw.name: In re Estate of Hiller
caselaw.topic: Personal representative — breach of fiduciary duty; removal/surcharge
caselaw.holding: A personal representative who wrongfully depleted estate assets breached the fiduciary duty owed to the estate; such conduct supports removal and a surcharge. (Decided under former 18-A; the fiduciary-duty and removal rules continue in 18-C §§3-703, 3-711/3-712 and 3-611.)
